title: Vendor risk & opportunity map for regulated industries (model landscape intelligence)
creator: Ayesha Gupta
summary: Produce a prioritized map of LLM vendors and open-model families focusing on regulatory readiness, procurement risk, commercial opportunity, and switch-cost vectors for Redwood’s enterprise and regulated customers.
objectives: Identify 12 vendor/model families with high likelihood of enterprise adoption in Finance, Healthcare, and Government sectors
Score each vendor across regulatory-readiness, data residency options, documented SOC/PEN audits, and enterprise SLAs
Estimate procurement friction and model-substitution cost (integration effort, tokenizer/ABI differences, rerun cost)
Produce go/no-go signals for Dedicated vs Private product motions and recommended product/packaging changes
deliverables: Consolidated vendor matrix CSV (columns: vendor, model-family, jurisdictional-readiness, KMS/HSM support, documented audits, pricing signal, latency profile, switch-cost index)
Confluence report: 10-page executive summary + recommended product levers
Dashboard: interactive ranking showing vendor risk/opportunity filters (region, use-case, price-sensitivity)
One-pager for sales & solutions engineering with procurement counter-arguments and negotiation playbook

Store canonical artifacts on Confluence (MMI workspace) and keep CSV in drive for automated ingestion by analytics team
